claim_zh: 以上结果说明，花托的快速生长以“库”容量信号为核心，整合KNAT2-like1、CRC和ER来调节细胞增殖。

classify_evidences.text: Based on these findings, we proposed that, in cucumber, the rapid growth of the receptacle is centred around sink capacity signalling and integration of KNAT2-like1, CRC and ER to regulate cell proliferation, ultimately promoting receptacle development.
